mapper.sql: credential.id, credential.account_id, account.user_handle, credential.credential_id, credential.public_key_cose, credential.signature_count, credential.transports, credential.backup_eligible, credential.backed_up, credential.name, credential.created_at, credential.last_used_at, credential.version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_passkey_account (account_id, user_handle) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{userHandle}) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_passkey_credential WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0

INSERT INTO auth_passkey_credential ( account_id, credential_id, public_key_cose, signature_count, transports, backup_eligible, backed_up, name ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{credentialId}, #{publicKeyCose}, #{signatureCount}, #{transports,typeHandler=com.sca4d.auth.passkey.credential.mapper.PasskeyTransportsTypeHandler}, #{backupEligible}, #{backedUp}, #{name} ) ON CONFLICT (credential_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_passkey_credential SET signature_count = #{newSignatureCount}, backed_up = #{backedUp}, last_used_at = #{usedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND signature_count = #{storedSignatureCount} AND ((#{storedSignatureCount} = 0 AND #{newSignatureCount} = 0) OR #{newSignatureCount} > #{storedSignatureCount}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0

WITH claimed_account AS ( UPDATE auth_passkey_account account SET version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND version = #{expectedAccountVersion} AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_passkey_credential credential WHERE credential.account_id = account.account_id AND credential.status = 'ACTIVE' AND credential.deleted = 0 ) > #{minimumRemainingCredentials} RETURNING account_id ) UPDATE auth_passkey_credential credential SET status = 'DISABLED', deleted = 1, version = version + 1 FROM claimed_account WHERE credential.account_id = claimed_account.account_id AND credential.id = #{id} AND credential.version = #{expectedCredentialVersion} AND credential.status = 'ACTIVE' AND credential.deleted = 0
